Chapter 1
General Provisions
Article 1.­
The purpose of this Prakas is to set forth regulatory framework for Bancassurance
business of banks and financial institutions aiming at enhancing financial inclusion by increase
accessibility of insurance services to the public, and strengthening consumer protection.
